column1: Table 1. The hearing range and sensitivity of domestic birds and mammals compared with that of humans

Species are listed in descending order of high-frequency hearing and then low-frequency hearing. Low- and high-frequency limits are the lowest and highest frequencies audible at 60 dB (re 20 µN/m²). Best sensitivity is a species’ lowest threshold and best frequency is the frequency at which it occurs.
For individual data, see Fay (1988) and Heffner and Heffner (1992a).
